caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal strip featuring a thick, wavy, dark green vine that extends from the left edge to the right edge. Along the vine, various flowers and leaves are distributed. The flowers include a blue, star-shaped flower near the left, a pink multi-petaled flower, a large yellow flower with a dark brown and light center, a smaller red flower with radiating petals, a pink flower with spiky petals, and multiple small red and pink blossoms throughout. There are also green crescent-shaped leaves with yellow highlights and some smaller green leaves attached to the vine. The background is a textured beige surface, and the floral elements are spaced at intervals along the length of the vine, creating a repeating, decorative pattern.
title: Crewel Embroidery (Border)
